name: Koujina Sono
source:
She is a serious girl with a strong sense of responsibility.  Despite her appearance as the savior of the earth, she is the only one who can fight on equal terms with Barbaroi.

She is always afraid inside and the pressure of safeguarding the fate of mankind wears out her heart.

[From [url=http://www.ordin-soft.com/suzuha.html]official site[/url]]
